description: Agent Insight. Runs and steps come from standard duration metrics; conversations and users are read from traces because high-cardinality ids must not enter metric dimensions (R-11.1-01). Content columns require OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT=true.

panels.description: One end-to-end workflow execution. Look here when workload or failure rate changes.
